title: AI can write code, but the magic of a first project is unmatched! 🗽
excerpt: Namaste dev community! 👋 Today, I’m sharing a very special project of mine. It's a web page...
content_html:
Community praises the buggy first project

Namaste dev community! 👋

Today, I’m sharing a very special project of mine. It's a web page featuring all the states of India.
Before you dive into the code, let me be completely honest—I know this project isn't perfect, and it probably has quite a few bugs because this is literally my very first project!

And yes, I know that today AI can generate an HTML file in just a second. You ask for it, and AI puts the whole code right in front of you.

Even so, I chose to build this myself, using my own mind and some ai. Because as a beginner, when you struggle through errors and write the code yourself, the learning you get is something you can never get from a simple copy-paste.

Demo

One more thing... 🌍

I don’t just love my own country; I deeply respect and appreciate all countries around the world. I love learning about different cultures and places, and I just wanted to start by showcasing all the states of my own beloved country, India!

🛠️ My Tech Stack

  • HTML & CSS
  • JavaScript (Still learning and applying step by step!)

Happy coding🗽

not cool.😔
